5:1: O you who believe, fulfill the contracts. Livestock animals have been made lawful for you, except those that will be recited to you, without deeming game lawful while you are in ihram. Surely Allah decrees what He wills.
5:2: O you who believe! Do not deem lawful (violate) the symbols of Allah, the sacred month, the hady (sacrificial animals), the qala'id (garlanded animals), and those coming to the Sacred House seeking bounty and approval from their Rabb. When you come out of ihram, hunt. Let not the hatred you feel because a people kept you from al-Masjid al-Haram drive you to transgression. Help one another in goodness and taqwa, and do not help one another in sin and hostility. Fear Allah. Surely Allah's punishment is severe.
5:3: Dead animals, blood, swine flesh, that which is slaughtered in the name of other than Allah, the strangled, that which died from a blow, that which died by falling, that which died by goring, and that which a beast of prey has eaten have been made forbidden to you, except what you slaughter; and that which is slaughtered on stone altars, and that you seek destiny with divining arrows (has also been made forbidden to you); this is fisq (transgression). Today those who disbelieve have despaired of your religion; do not fear them, fear Me. Today I have perfected your religion for you, completed My favor upon you, and approved Islam for you as religion. Whoever is compelled by hunger, without inclining toward sin (may eat); for Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
5:4: They ask you what has been made lawful for them, say: Clean things have been made lawful for you, and eat of what hunting animals catch for you as Allah has taught you, and mention the name of Allah over it, and fear Allah; surely Allah is swift in reckoning.
5:5: Today clean things have been made lawful for you. The food of those who were given the Book is lawful for you, and your food is lawful for them. Chaste women among the believing women and chaste women among those who were given the Book before you, provided that you give them their mahr (dowries), in chastity, not committing fornication, and not taking secret lovers (are lawful to you). Whoever denies faith, his deed has become void, and in the Hereafter he is among the losers.
5:6: O you who believe, when you rise for salah, wash your faces and your hands up to the elbows, wipe your heads, and wash your feet up to the ankles. If you are in a state of janabah, purify yourselves. If you are ill or on a journey, or one of you has come from the toilet, or you have touched women and you cannot find water, then perform tayammum with clean soil, wipe your faces and your hands with it. Allah does not want to cause you difficulty, but He wants to purify you and complete His favor upon you, so that you may be grateful.
5:7: Remember Allah's favor upon you and His covenant with which He bound you when you said, 'We have heard and we have obeyed.' Fear Allah. Surely Allah knows what is inside the breasts.
5:8: O you who believe, be those who stand for Allah, witnesses with justice. Let not your hatred for a people lead you to injustice. Be just, that is closer to taqwa. Fear Allah. Surely Allah is aware of what you do.
5:9: Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds that for them is forgiveness and a great reward.
5:10: And those who disbelieve and deny Our verses, they are the companions of Hell.
5:11: O you who believe, remember Allah's favor upon you. When a people intended to stretch out their hands against you, Allah restrained their hands from you. Fear Allah, and let the believers put their trust in Allah.
5:12: And Allah had certainly taken a pledge from the Children of Israel, and We sent from them twelve naqibs. Allah said: 'Surely I am with you. If you establish salah, give zakat, believe in My messengers, assist them, and give Allah a good loan, I will surely cover your evil deeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow. But whoever among you disbelieves after this has strayed from the right way.'
5:13: Because of their breaking their covenant, We cursed them and made their hearts hard. They distort words from their places and forgot a portion of what they were reminded of. Except for a few among them, you will constantly see betrayal from them. Forgive them and turn away. Surely Allah loves those who do good.
5:14: And from those who said, 'We are Christians,' We took their covenant. They also forgot a portion of what they were reminded of. Thereupon We cast enmity and hatred among them until the Day of Resurrection. Allah will inform them of what they used to do.
5:15: O People of the Book! Our Messenger has come to you, making clear to you much of what you were concealing of the Book and passing over much. There has come to you from Allah a light and a clear Book.
5:16: With it, Allah guides those who seek His pleasure to the ways of peace, and brings them out of darkness into light by His permission, and guides them to a straight path.
5:17: Certainly, those who said, "Allah is the Messiah, son of Mary" have disbelieved. Say: "If Allah willed to destroy the Messiah, son of Mary, his mother, and everyone on the earth, who could possess anything against Allah?" The kingdom of the heavens, the earth, and what is between them belongs to Allah. He creates what He wills. Allah is capable of all things.
5:18: The Jews and the Christians said: "We are the sons of Allah and His beloved ones." Say: "Then why does He punish you for your sins?" Rather, you are human beings among those He created. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. The kingdom of the heavens, the earth, and what is between them belongs to Allah. And to Him is the return.
5:19: O People of the Book! Our messenger has come to you in a period when messengers had ceased, lest you say, "No bearer of good tidings and no warner came to us." Indeed, a bearer of good tidings and a warner has come to you. Allah is capable of all things.
5:20: When Moses said to his people: 'O my people! Remember Allah's favor upon you. When He made prophets among you and made you kings, and gave you what He did not give to anyone among the worlds.'
5:21: O my people! Enter the holy land which Allah has written for you, and do not turn your backs, or you will become losers.
5:22: They said: "O Moses! Surely there is a tyrannical people in it, and we will never enter it until they leave it. If they leave it, then we will enter."
5:23: Two men from among those who feared, whom Allah had favored, said: "Enter upon them through the gate. When you enter it, surely you will be victorious. And put your trust in Allah if you are believers."
5:24: They said: "O Moses! As long as they are there, we will never, ever enter it. Go, you and your Rabb, and fight; surely we are sitting right here."
5:25: He said: "My Rabb, surely I possess none but myself and my brother. So separate between us and the transgressive (fasiq) people."
5:26: He said: "Then surely it is forbidden to them for forty years. They will wander bewildered in the earth. So do not grieve over the transgressive (fasiq) people."
5:27: And recite to them the story of the two sons of Adam with truth. When they both offered a sacrifice, and it was accepted from one of them and was not accepted from the other. He said: 'I will surely kill you.' He said: 'Allah accepts only from the righteous (al-muttaqin).'
5:28: If you stretch out your hand against me to kill me, I will not stretch out my hand against you to kill you, because I fear Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
5:29: Surely I wish that you bear my sin and your own sin and thus become of the companions of the Fire, and that is the recompense of the wrongdoers.
5:30: Thereupon his soul prompted him to kill his brother, so he killed him and became of the losers.
5:31: Then Allah sent a crow scratching in the ground to show him how to conceal the corpse of his brother. He said: "Woe to me! Am I unable to be like this crow and conceal the corpse of my brother?" Thus he became of the regretful.
5:32: Because of that, We decreed for the Children of Israel: Whoever kills a soul—unless for a soul or for corruption in the earth—it is as if he had killed all of mankind. And whoever gives life to it, it is as if he had given life to all of mankind. And Our messengers certainly came to them with clear proofs; yet even after that, many of them became transgressors in the earth.
5:33: The recompense of those who wage war against Allah and His Messenger and strive to spread corruption in the earth is only that they be killed or crucified, or that their hands and feet be cut off on opposite sides, or that they be exiled from the land. That is a disgrace for them in this world, and for them in the Hereafter is a great punishment.
5:34: Except those who repent before you overpower them. Know that surely Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
5:35: O you who believe, beware of Allah and seek the means of approach (wasilah) to Him and strive (jihad) in His cause so that you may attain salvation.
5:36: Surely those who disbelieve, even if they had all that is on the earth and the like of it with it to ransom themselves from the punishment of the Day of Resurrection, it would not be accepted from them. And for them is a painful punishment.
5:37: They wish to come out of the Fire, and they will not come out of it. And for them is an enduring punishment.
5:38: As for the male thief and the female thief, cut off their hands as a deterrent punishment in return for what they earned. This is a penalty from Allah.
5:39: Whoever repents after his wrongdoing and reforms, surely Allah accepts his repentance. Surely Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
5:40: Do you not know that surely to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth? He punishes whom He wills and forgives whom He wills. Allah is capable of all things.
5:41: O Messenger! Let not those grieve you who hasten into disbelief from among those who say with their mouths 'We believe' while their hearts have not believed, and from among the Jews. They are listeners to falsehood, listeners on behalf of another folk who have not come to you. They displace words from their contexts. They say, 'If you are given this, take it; but if you are not given it, beware.' Whomever Allah wills to put to trial, you have no power for him against Allah at all. Those are the ones whose hearts Allah does not will to purify. For them in this world is disgrace, and in the Hereafter is a great punishment.
5:42: They are avid listeners to falsehood, avid devourers of what is forbidden (haram). If they come to you, judge between them or turn away from them. And if you turn away from them, they cannot harm you at all. And if you judge, judge between them with justice. Surely Allah loves those who act justly.
5:43: And how do they make you their judge when they have the Torah, in which is the judgment of Allah, then they turn away after that? Those are not believers.
5:44: Surely We sent down the Torah; in it is guidance and light. The prophets who had submitted judged by it for the Jews, as did the rabbis and the scholars, according to what they were entrusted with of the Book of Allah and were witnesses over it. So do not fear the people, but fear Me, and do not sell My verses for a small price. Whoever does not judge by what Allah has sent down, then those are the disbelievers themselves.
5:45: And We ordained for them in it: a life for a life, an eye for an eye, a nose for a nose, an ear for an ear, a tooth for a tooth, and for wounds there is retaliation (qisas). But whoever donates it as charity, it shall be an expiation for him. And whoever does not judge by what Allah has sent down, then those are the wrongdoers themselves.
5:46: And in their footsteps We sent Jesus, son of Mary, confirming what came before him of the Torah; and We gave him the Gospel (Injil), in which is guidance and light, confirming what came before him of the Torah, and as a guidance and an admonition for the righteous (al-muttaqin).
5:47: And let the people of the Gospel judge by what Allah has sent down in it. And whoever does not judge by what Allah has sent down, then those are the defiantly disobedient (fasiqs) themselves.
5:48: And We have sent down to you the Book with truth, confirming the Book that came before it and as a guardian over it. So judge between them by what Allah has sent down, and do not follow their desires away from the truth that has come to you. For each of you We have prescribed a law (shariah) and a clear path. Had Allah willed, He would have made you a single community (ummah), but He intended to test you in what He gave you. So race to good deeds. Unto Allah is the return of you all together; then He will inform you about that wherein you used to differ.
5:49: And judge between them by what Allah has sent down, and do not follow their desires, and beware of them lest they seduce you away from some of what Allah has sent down to you. And if they turn away, know that Allah only intends to afflict them for some of their sins. And surely many among the people are defiantly disobedient (fasiq).
5:50: Do they then seek the judgment of the time of ignorance (jahiliyyah)? And who is better than Allah in judgment for a people who are certain in faith?
5:51: O you who believe, do not take the Jews and the Christians as allies; they are allies of one another. And whoever among you allies himself with them, then surely he is one of them. Surely Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.
5:52: You see those in whose hearts is a disease hastening toward them, saying: 'We fear that a misfortune may strike us.' Perhaps Allah will bring a victory or a command from Himself, and they will become regretful over what they concealed within themselves.
5:53: Those who believe say: 'Are these the ones who swore by Allah with the utmost strength of their oaths that they were with you?' Their deeds became worthless, and they became the losers.
5:54: O you who believe! Whoever of you turns back from his religion, Allah will soon bring a people whom He loves and who love Him, humble toward the believers, strong against the disbelievers, striving in the cause of Allah and not fearing the blame of any blamer. That is the bounty of Allah; He gives it to whom He wills. Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.
5:55: Your ally is only Allah, His Messenger, and those who believe; those who establish salah, give zakat, and bow down.
5:56: Whoever takes Allah, His messenger, and those who believe as allies, then surely the party of Allah are the victorious.
5:57: O you who believe, do not take as allies those who take your religion in mockery and play from among those who were given the Scripture before you, and the disbelievers. Fear Allah, if you are believers.
5:58: When you call to salah, they take it in mockery and play. That is because they are a people who do not reason.
5:59: Say: O People of the Scripture! Do you dislike anything about us other than that we believe in Allah, in what has been revealed to us, and in what was revealed before, and that most of you are defiantly disobedient?
5:60: Say: Shall I inform you of a worse penalty than that from Allah? It is those whom Allah has cursed, upon whom He has been wrathful, from whom He made monkeys and swine, and those who worship taghut. Those are worse in place and more astray from the straight path.
5:61: When they come to you, they say 'We believe', whereas they had entered with disbelief and indeed departed with it; and Allah knows best what they were concealing.
5:62: You see many of them rushing into sin, enmity, and eating what is forbidden; how evil is what they have been doing.
5:63: Should not the rabbanis and the rabbis have forbidden them from their sinful words and eating what is forbidden? What evil things they used to do.
5:64: The Jews said: 'Allah's hand is tied.' Their hands have been tied and they were cursed for what they said. On the contrary, His two hands are open; He spends as He wills. And what has been revealed to you from your Rabb will surely increase many of them in rebellion and disbelief. And We cast between them enmity and hatred until the Day of Resurrection. Whenever they kindle a fire for war, Allah extinguishes it. And they rush to spread corruption on earth. Allah does not love the corrupters.
5:65: If the People of the Scripture had believed and guarded themselves, We would surely have covered their evils and would surely have admitted them into gardens of bliss.
5:66: If they had duly implemented the Torah, the Gospel, and what was revealed to them from their Rabb, they would surely have eaten from above them and from beneath their feet. Among them is a moderate community; but as for many of them, evil is what they do.
5:67: O messenger! Proclaim what has been revealed to you from your Rabb. And if you do not, you will not have proclaimed His message. Allah will protect you from the people. Surely Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.
5:68: Say: O People of the Scripture! You are not upon anything until you implement the Torah, the Gospel, and what has been revealed to you from your Rabb. And what has been revealed to you from your Rabb will surely increase many of them in rebellion and disbelief. So do not grieve over the disbelieving people.
5:69: Surely those who believe, the Jews, the Sabians, and the Christians—whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day and works righteousness—there shall be no fear upon them, nor shall they grieve.
5:70: By oath, We took a pledge from the Children of Israel and sent messengers to them. Whenever a messenger came to them with something their souls did not desire, a group they denied, and a group they killed.
5:71: They thought that there would be no tribulation, so they became blind and deaf. Then Allah accepted their repentance. Then again many of them became blind and deaf. Allah is the Seer of what they do.
5:72: By oath, those who said, "Allah is the Messiah, son of Mary" have surely disbelieved. Whereas the Messiah said: "O Children of Israel, worship Allah, my Rabb and your Rabb." Surely whoever associates partners with Allah, Allah has forbidden Paradise for him, and his refuge is the Fire. For the wrongdoers there are no helpers.
5:73: By oath, those who said, "Allah is the third of three" have disbelieved. Yet there is no deity except one God. If they do not desist from what they say, a painful punishment will surely touch those of them who disbelieve.
5:74: Will they still not repent to Allah and ask forgiveness of Him? Allah is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.
5:75: The Messiah, son of Mary, is only a messenger; messengers have passed away before him. His mother is a truthful woman. Both of them used to eat food. Look how We make the signs clear to them, then look how they turn away.
5:76: Say: "Do you worship besides Allah that which has no power to harm or benefit you?" Allah is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
5:77: Say: "O People of the Scripture! Do not unjustly exceed limits in your religion, and do not follow the desires of a people who went astray before, led many astray, and strayed from the straight path."
5:78: Those who disbelieved from among the Children of Israel were cursed by the tongue of David and of Jesus, son of Mary. That was because they rebelled and exceeded the limits.
5:79: They would not restrain one another from the munkar they committed. How evil was what they were doing.
5:80: You see many of them taking those who disbelieve as allies. How evil is what their souls have put forth for them! Allah has become wrathful with them, and in the punishment they will abide eternally.
5:81: If they had believed in Allah, the Prophet, and what was revealed to him, they would not have taken them as allies; but most of them are defiantly disobedient.
5:82: You will surely find the most intense of people in enmity toward those who believe to be the Jews and those who associate partners with Allah; and you will find the nearest of them in affection toward those who believe to be those who say: 'We are Christians.'
5:83: When they hear what was revealed to the Messenger, you see their eyes overflowing with tears because of what they recognized of the truth. They say: Our Rabb! We have believed, so register us with the witnesses.
5:84: What is the matter with us that we should not believe in Allah and what has come to us of the truth, and hope that our Rabb will admit us into Paradise along with the righteous people?
5:85: Allah rewarded them for what they said with gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein. And that is the reward of the doers of good.
5:86: And those who disbelieve and belie Our verses, they are the companions of Hell.
5:87: O you who believe! Do not forbid the good things that Allah has made lawful to you, and do not exceed the limits. Indeed, Allah does not love the transgressors.
5:88: Eat of what Allah has provided you as lawful and wholesome, and fear Allah, in Whom you believe.
5:89: Allah does not hold you accountable for the vain speech in your oaths, but He holds you accountable for what you have bound of oaths. Its expiation is feeding ten poor persons from the average of what you feed your families, or clothing them, or freeing a neck (slave). Whoever cannot find (the means) must fast three days. That is the expiation of your oaths when you swear. Guard your oaths. Thus does Allah make clear His verses to you, that you may be grateful.
5:90: O you who believe! Intoxicants, gambling, stone altars, and divining arrows are only an abomination from the handiwork of Satan, so avoid it that you may attain salvation.
5:91: Satan only wishes to cause enmity and hatred among you through intoxicants and gambling, and to hinder you from the remembrance of Allah and from salah. Will you then desist (from them)?
5:92: Obey Allah, obey the Messenger, and beware. If you turn away, then know that upon Our Messenger is only the clear delivery (of the message).
5:93: There is no sin upon those who believe and do righteous deeds in what they have eaten, as long as they are mindful (of Allah) and believe and do righteous deeds, then are mindful and believe, then are mindful and do good; and Allah loves the doers of good.
5:94: O you who believe! Allah will surely test you with something of the game that your hands and your spears reach, so that Allah may know who fears Him in the unseen. So whoever transgresses after that, for him there is a painful punishment.
5:95: O you who believe, do not kill game while you are in ihram. Whoever among you kills it intentionally, the penalty is the equivalent of what he killed in livestock – two just persons among you judge it – as an offering to reach the Ka'bah, or an expiation: feeding poor people, or the equivalent of that in fasting, so that he may taste the consequence of his deed. Allah has forgiven what is past. Whoever repeats it, Allah will take retribution from him. Allah is Mighty, Owner of Retribution.
5:96: The game of the sea and its food have been made lawful to you and to travelers as provision, and land game has been made unlawful to you as long as you are in ihram; and fear Allah, to Whom you will be gathered.
5:97: Allah made the Ka'bah, the sacred house, a support for people, as well as the sacred month, the sacrificial offering, and the garlands; this is so that you may know that Allah knows what is in the heavens and what is in the earth, and that Allah is the Knower of all things.
5:98: Know that Allah is severe in punishment, and know that Allah is Much-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
5:99: Nothing is upon the Messenger except conveying (the message), and Allah knows what you disclose and what you conceal.
5:100: Say: The bad and the good are not equal, even if the abundance of the bad pleases you. O people of understanding, fear Allah so that you may attain salvation.
5:101: O you who believe, do not ask about things which, if disclosed to you, would distress you. If you ask about them while the Quran is being revealed, they will be disclosed to you. Allah has forgiven them. Allah is Forgiving, Halim (Most Forbearing).
5:102: A people before you had asked about them, then they became disbelievers on account of them.
5:103: Allah has appointed neither Bahirah, nor Sa'ibah, nor Wasilah, nor Ham, but those who disbelieve fabricate lies against Allah, and most of them do not use reason.
5:104: When it is said to them, 'Come to what Allah has revealed and to the Messenger,' they say, 'Sufficient for us is what we found our fathers upon,' even if their fathers knew nothing and were not rightly guided.
5:105: O you who believe, upon you are yourselves. He who goes astray cannot harm you when you are guided. To Allah is the return of you all, so He will inform you of what you used to do.
5:106: O you who believe, testimony among you when death approaches one of you, at the time of making a will, is two just men from among you, or two others from other than you if the calamity of death strikes you while you are traveling on earth. You detain them after the salah; if you doubt, they swear by Allah: 'We will not sell it for any price, even if he were a near relative, and we will not conceal the testimony of Allah; otherwise, we would surely be of the sinners.'
5:107: If it becomes evident that they are guilty of a sin, then two others from those closest (to the deceased) take their place and swear by Allah: 'Our testimony is truer than their testimony and we have not transgressed; in that case, we would surely be of the wrongdoers.'
5:108: That is more likely that they will bring the testimony according to its true form, or fear that oaths would be refuted after their oaths. Fear Allah and listen. Allah does not guide the defiant people.
5:109: The Day Allah will assemble the messengers and say, 'What response did you receive?' They will say, 'We have no knowledge. Indeed, You are the Knower of the unseen.'
5:110: When Allah said: 'O Jesus, son of Mary, remember My favor upon you and upon your mother. When I supported you with the Ruh al-Qudus (Holy Spirit). You spoke to people in the cradle and in maturity. When I taught you the Book, the Wisdom, the Torah, and the Gospel. When by My permission you created from clay in the shape of a bird, then you breathed into it and it became a bird by My permission. By My permission you healed the born blind and the leper. When by My permission you brought forth the dead. When I restrained the Children of Israel from you when you came to them with clear proofs, and those who disbelieved among them said: This is nothing but clear magic.'
5:111: And when I inspired the disciples, 'Believe in Me and in My Messenger,' they said, 'We believe, and bear witness that we are Muslims.'
5:112: When the disciples said: 'O Jesus, son of Mary, can your Rabb send down to us a table spread from the heaven?' He said: 'Fear Allah, if you are believers.'
5:113: They said: 'We wish to eat from it and that our hearts be reassured, and to know that you have spoken the truth to us and to be among the witnesses over it.'
5:114: Jesus, son of Mary, said: 'O Allah, our Rabb, send down to us a table spread from the heaven to be for us a festival—for the first of us and the last of us—and a sign from You. And provide for us, and You are the best of providers.'
5:115: Allah said: Indeed, I will send it down to you. Whoever among you disbelieves after this, indeed, I will punish him with a punishment with which I do not punish anyone from the worlds.
5:116: At that time Allah said: 'O Jesus, son of Mary! Did you say to the people, 'Take me and my mother as two deities besides Allah'?' He said: 'Glory be to You! It is not befitting for me to say a thing that I have no right to. If I have said it, You surely have known it. You know what is in my self, but I do not know what is in Your self. Indeed You, You are the One who knows the unseens very well.'
5:117: I only said to them what You commanded me: Worship Allah, who is my Rabb and your Rabb. And I was a witness over them as long as I was among them. But when You caused me to die, You were the watcher over them. You are a witness over all things.
5:118: If You punish them, indeed they are Your servants, and if You forgive them, indeed You are superior and the possessor of wisdom.
5:119: Allah said: This is the day when their truthfulness will benefit the truthful. For them are gardens beneath which rivers flow, they will remain there forever. Allah is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. This is the great success.
5:120: The sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and whatever is in them belongs to Allah, and He is capable of all things.
